_provenance: γ = −mean(NN stacking ΔG), SantaLucia 1998; READ-ONLY measured human promoters (Homo sapiens, TSS-2000..+500) fetched by fetch_full_sensory_gamma.py from NCBI eutils, corr(γ,GC)=0.997 over the 13 new genes — same scale/window/NN table as the taste atlas (0.995) and organ atlas (0.994). These complete the sensory atlas: low-threshold touch and high-threshold nociception (somatosensory submodalities on the emerged skin organ), proprioception (muscle spindle, closing the §11 reflex loop), and the vestibular hair cell. Layer-1 [F] uses these γ; absolute size/time/threshold is Layer-2 [O]. TP63 reused from sensory_organ_gamma.json (skin master).
